summary: Frontend-only regression testing of iteration 68 (UI cleanups). Tested WEB Trade toolbar + STOP ANANTA relocation, WEB Strategy Center card cleanup + pencil edit, WEB 4-step OnboardingPipeline, and NEW mobile 4-step ProvisioningPipeline. All items pass EXCEPT the WEB STOP ANANTA header-slot render: the button is not visible on the Trade tab because AppShell's ContextInfo does not mount #header-action-slot for the 'trade' (and 'dashboard') branch — HeaderActionPortal has no target to portal into. Mobile onboarding provisioning tour works end-to-end.

ui_bugs.issue: STOP ANANTA button never renders on Trade tab. Trade.jsx portals it into HeaderActionPortal (#header-action-slot), but AppShell.jsx ContextInfo() returns EARLY for id==='trade' and id==='dashboard' without rendering the <div id='header-action-slot'>. Result: HeaderActionPortal has no target -> button is missing entirely. Verified: querySelector('#header-action-slot') === null on Trade tab; querySelector('[data-testid="trade-stop-ananta"]') === null. Reference: /app/frontend/src/AppShell.jsx:255-272 (trade branch) and :235-253 (dashboard branch) both return before line 286 where the slot is rendered.

After the fix, re-verify: (a) [data-testid='trade-stop-ananta'] exists on Trade tab, (b) initial label 'STOP ANANTA', (c) click toggles to 'RESUME' and back, (d) button lives inside header slot (not inside [data-testid='trade-toolbar']).

Consider always rendering the slot regardless of tab id (e.g., render it in the parent wrapper alongside ContextInfo) so tabs that opt-in via HeaderActionPortal aren't dependent on which branch is hit.

Trade.jsx line 82-90: the STOP ANANTA button is the ONLY control mounted via HeaderActionPortal from Trade.jsx — a defensive fallback (render inline if portal target absent) could prevent this class of regressions.

rca of the issue: AppShell.jsx's ContextInfo function renders three different layouts depending on tab id. Only the third fallback branch (id in ['strategies','research','workspace']) contains <div id='header-action-slot' />. For id==='dashboard' and id==='trade', the function returns before reaching that JSX. HeaderActionPortal (components/HeaderActionPortal.jsx) polls document.getElementById('header-action-slot') via rAF until it finds it — on the Trade tab it never resolves, so no portal is created and Trade.jsx's STOP ANANTA <button> is never inserted into the DOM. Fix: render #header-action-slot unconditionally (e.g., add it inside the 'trade' branch alongside the Metric row, or restructure so the slot lives outside of ContextInfo). Reproduction: as owner, navigate to Trade tab -> inspect DOM: neither #header-action-slot nor [data-testid='trade-stop-ananta'] exists. On Strategy tab both do exist and the portal works (Search + Add pills visible next to the 'Strategy Center' title).
